title: Active Testing: An Unbiased Evaluation Method for Distantly Supervised Relation Extraction
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical problem in natural language processing: correcting for statistical bias in the evaluation of relation extraction models due to noisy, automatically-labeled test data.
